messages.subject: Re: manipulation of branch color
parts:
Dear Tzu-Hao,
is this question only for the developer, or may other persons answer it?

p <- ggtree(tree, aes(color=isTip)) + scale_color_manual(values=c("black","red"))
p

To get an idea what is going on type: str(p$data)
Greetings :)
